note: Verified-outcomes ledger for data/market-calendar.json, read only by scripts/apply-calendar-outcomes.cjs. An entry counts as verified ONLY when decision, reaction, source, and verifiedAt are all present and non-empty; anything less is ignored and the event is left open (fail closed). Keys use the same event id scheme as scripts/sync-market-events.cjs: <type>-<date>. Entries are curated from figures the brief pipeline has already verified (Jun's graded event record); the narrative brief itself is prose and is never scraped for figures. Provenance (source/verifiedAt) stays in this ledger — the calendar outcome schema carries only decision + reaction.

cpi-2026-10-14.decision: September CPI printed hot (BLS, Oct 14, 8:30 AM ET): headline +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — core a tenth above the +0.2% consensus anchor, with gasoline (+9.1% m/m) driving over half the headline increase.
cpi-2026-10-14.reaction: The 10-year spiked ~9bp intraday to ~5.31% but closed Oct 14 at 5.19% — inside the 5.2–5.5% containment band, not a falsifier trip. October hike odds repriced from ~22% to roughly 40% for the Oct 27–28 FOMC. Bank credit did not crack on the print (BAC's drop was a $1.2B Treasury settlement charge, not provisions).
cpi-2026-10-14.source: Jun's verified record: Oct 14, 2026 CPI grading (print, gasoline share, hike-odds repricing, BAC settlement charge) and Oct 16 Friday thesis bond section (10Y Oct 14 cash close 5.19%). Prepared as research_notes/capradar-calendar-outcome-draft-2026-10-17.md.
